work.description: The act provides Luigi Lastaria to the united sees of Zante and Cephalonia. Issuer evidence GREGORIUS PP. XVI at LF10582; own dating clause LF10708–10711 reads: Datum Romae apud s. Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die quarta novembris millesimo octin- gentesimo trigesimo primo pontificatus Nostri anno primo.. Own provenance note LF10593 excluded as edition furniture. Refined body and full surrounding frame read literally. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
